results.note: The revised paper explicitly identifies its evaluated model as SAM 2.1. Figure 12 reports average J&F 80.3 across nine densely annotated video datasets under the interactive offline protocol with eight interacted frames and three clicks per interacted frame. That is not three clicks total. Difficult thin, fast, occluded and crowded cases remain outside an unattended-quality claim.

setup.note: Current INSTALL requirements and kijai’s actual SAM 2.1 Large loading/propagate/export implementation were rechecked. The official Large endpoint returned TLS-valid HTTP 206 for a one-byte range today; this verifies endpoint availability only, not complete checkpoint contents. The scoped path keeps state on GPU, without offload_state_to_cpu=True.

maintenance.note: Current issue 779 about expired checkpoint TLS is closed, and the selected official endpoint was reachable with normal certificate validation. Open issue 780 reports stale/empty prompt-return masks under CPU-state offload on a busy GPU; propagation is reported separately. CPU-state offload is excluded from this selected workflow rather than declared fixed.

independent_use.note: The current kijai integration loads official checkpoints and propagates masks through video with exportable outputs. This is an actual independent implementation, not a directory or popularity count.
